front.note: Recessed firebox, brick joints and grate read clearly, but timber highlights form an artificial checker pattern.

rear.note: Rear posts meet the cap; the broad timber rear face repeats the same overly regular surface pattern.

detail.note: Full-size detail confirms waffle-like roughness across the walnut cap; replace it with grain-aligned roughness.

underside.note: Solid plinth supports the firebox; the lower angle makes the timber checker highlights more conspicuous.

clay.note: Clay confirms layered masonry, rounded cap edges and separated log/grate construction; reject the timber material only.

front.note: Blue upholstered frame, layered mattress and paired lofted pillows form a coherent low platform bed.

rear.note: Rear headboard panels remain joined to the side rails; duvet perimeter stays on the mattress.

detail.note: Tone-on-tone quilt channels and continuous pillow piping remain seated against the softened bedding.

underside.note: Recessed dark platform is closed and supports the frame; no detached underside pieces are visible.

clay.note: Clay separates the pillow loft, quilt edge, mattress and frame with restrained rounded corners.

front.note: Three seat cushions, low arms and metal feet retain a clear connected sofa silhouette.

rear.note: Layered back carcass connects both arms; the three back pads sit against it without floating.

detail.note: Seat corners show restrained compression folds and soft covers; green upholstery remains matte.

underside.note: Closed support base and four slim legs contact the frame; seat edges do not penetrate the underside.

clay.note: Clay reveals shaped cushions and small gaps between pads rather than merged pillow blobs.

front.note: Dense individual needles surround branching shoots and retain the narrow species-specific conifer crown.

rear.note: Rear crown is comparably dense with modest asymmetry rather than a flat or empty back.

detail.note: Close view resolves many fine needles and layered shoots; foliage has restrained green variation.

underside.note: Trunk and lower branch attachment remain visible through the hanging lower crown.

clay.note: Clay shows actual needle geometry and tiered branching, with the outer silhouette preserved.

front.note: Tapered ceramic base, narrow neck and open linen shade form a balanced bedside lamp.

rear.note: Rear silhouette retains the open top and continuous thin shade rim without a solid cap.

detail.note: Fine shade grain and timber neck contrast gently with the smooth ceramic base.

underside.note: Open lower shade reveals the socket and radial support arms; the stem is connected.

clay.note: Clay confirms the hollow tapered shade and layered base foot, with no isolated floating components.

front.note: Curved hanging shoots carry individual narrow leaves around the branching trunk.

rear.note: Rear view retains layered drooping foliage and a visible woody branch structure.

detail.note: Close view resolves leaflets along many curved stems rather than broad foliage cards.

underside.note: Lowest drooping branches surround the rooted trunk; no loose detached foliage pieces are apparent.

clay.note: Clay confirms the cascading geometry and open spaces between branches; this remains a stylized detailed tree.
